newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dollar ends unchanged after tight range trade.
newsitem.headline: NZ dollar ends unchanged after tight range trade.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended unchanged on Wednesday after a tight trading session that saw the Kiwi confined within a US$0.6995-10 band.
"There were a few bits and pieces going through, but as you can see by the range there wasn't much going on," said one Auckland dealer.
Kiwi finished at 0.7097/04, exactly level with its opening, and little-changed on the Trade-Weighted Index at 67.54.
For the time being, the Kiwi is not expected to venture too far outside 0.6990-20.
But with renewed talk of still more dual currency issuance, the top end of the range was likely to be breached if such issues materialised.
